description: Users in the regional sales office cannot connect to corporate VPN. Error shows TLS handshake failed.
resolution_notes: Restarted stalled IPsec service on secondary gateway concentrator. Flushed cached sessions.

description: Senior accountant cannot login to corporate portal due to account locked out after multiple attempts.
resolution_notes: Identified old cached credential on user iPad sending bad passwords. Unlocked account and forced password reset.

description: Customer checkout API returning HTTP 500 errors after automated midnight deployment pipeline.
resolution_notes: Initiated immediate container rollback to previous stable tag v2.4.1. Root cause was missing environment variable.

description: Entire marketing department reports corporate Outlook emails are delayed by 2 hours.
resolution_notes: Cleared stuck message spool in edge spam filter and adjusted inbound SMTP throttling thresholds.

description: Production database connections failing with max client connections reached error.
resolution_notes: Identified leaky connection pool in reporting microservice. Terminated idle transactions and scaled PgBouncer.

description: Finance manager requests installation and license activation for PowerBI Pro Desktop.
resolution_notes: Verified manager approval in ticketing system and assigned available PowerBI Pro license seat via Intune.

description: Employee received urgent email claiming to be CEO requesting payroll bank change with external link.
resolution_notes: Isolated workstation via EDR, revoked user tokens, reset credentials, and purged phishing email from tenant.

description: Wi-Fi connectivity is dropping continuously in Building 3 second floor conference room.
resolution_notes: Rebooted overloaded wireless access point AP-302 and reassigned radio channel to avoid 5GHz interference.

description: New hire needs read and write permissions to the shared operations network drive folder.
resolution_notes: Added user to AD Security Group 'Sec-Ops-Share-RW' following manager ticket approval.

description: Enterprise ERP inventory sync job taking 10x normal execution time and causing timeouts.
resolution_notes: Rebuilt fragmented database index on inventory_ledger table and updated optimizer statistics.

description: EDR alert: suspicious PowerShell execution with encoded command detected on developer workstation.
resolution_notes: Triaged alert; determined command was legitimate npm build script. Added path exception to SOC watch list.

description: Production database read replica has fallen 45 minutes behind primary node.
resolution_notes: Killed long-running analytical query blocking WAL apply thread. Replication lag dropped to zero within 10 min.

description: User Outlook desktop client crashing immediately upon launch with mso20win32client.dll error.
resolution_notes: Repaired Microsoft 365 desktop installation and rebuilt corrupted local Outlook profile.

description: All company Slack channels failing to deliver outbound messages with WebSocket error.
resolution_notes: Third-party Slack service outage confirmed via vendor status page. Informed staff via email broadcast until restored.

description: Developer cannot access Git repositories; SSH key authentication fails with Permission Denied.
resolution_notes: Updated expired public SSH key on internal GitLab profile and verified repository group permissions.

description: Core distribution switch stack dropped redundant uplink; single point of failure alarm active.
resolution_notes: Replaced failed 10Gbps SFP+ optical transceiver module on switch port TenGig 1/0/48.

description: Data analyst requests Docker Desktop installation on corporate Windows laptop.
resolution_notes: Enabled WSL2 feature, installed corporate licensed Docker Desktop build, and verified container startup.

description: Internal documentation wiki server returning 502 Bad Gateway.
resolution_notes: Restarted failed gunicorn service on wiki application host and rotated bloated access logs.

description: Batch billing invoice generation service halted with OutOfMemoryError heap dump generated.
resolution_notes: Restarted JVM with increased max heap allocation (-Xmx8g) and queued batch in smaller chunks of 500 records.

description: Ransomware canary file modified alert triggered on fileserver share by unknown IP.
resolution_notes: Isolated fileserver, disabled SMB shares, located infected client machine, and restored file share from snapshot.
